stem.text: A metal wire is stretched by a load. The force-extension graph is shown.

stem.alt: Graph with force on the vertical axis and extension on the horizontal axis, with the origin marked 0. A straight line rises from the origin, then bends into a curve that rises more slowly, reaches a maximum and falls slightly at the end.

stem.text: What is represented by the area under the whole graph?

A.text: the change in gravitational potential energy of the wire

B.text: the energy that would be released from the wire if the final load was removed

C.text: the energy transferred into heat energy in the wire

D.text: the work done in stretching the wire
